method.strictParsing: Review-owned parsing rejected duplicate object names at top and nested levels, NaN, Infinity, -Infinity, decimal floats, exponent floats, and array floats. Candidate integers remained arbitrary-precision exact JSON integers until nominal u64/u128 validation.

v14SemanticParity.preservedSemantics: No finding, partial-finding, exact-Coverage, policy identity, policy verdict, derivation digest, deficiency, cancellation, or fault-cause field was lost or moved to the host. Policy verdict values remain pass/fail/advisory/indeterminate; fact deficiencies equal the pinned fact-plane vocabulary; faulted remains a value rather than HostTermination or an exception.

budgetSemantics.chargeRule: A successful rule or policy charge decrements the matching remaining counter by one and increments only its matching used counter by one. A zero counter fails before decrement or increment.
budgetSemantics.firstFailure: Rule exhaustion and policy exhaustion each selected the exact attempted coverageKey, returned incomplete/budget-exhausted/indeterminate, and stopped before every later charge, diagnostic, and return event.
budgetSemantics.usageEquality: Returned ruleUnits and policyUnits equaled the exact successful prefix and never exceeded their injected limits.
budgetSemantics.attemptedOverflow: The symbolic state after u64::MAX successful same-counter charges is used=u64::MAX, remaining=0. The next attempted charge fails and leaves used at u64::MAX; it neither wraps, saturates, nor continues.
budgetSemantics.invalidInputFate: Negative, boolean, float, and u64::MAX+1 limits reject before evaluation.

diagnosticsSemantics.retentionRule: The first min(capacity, attempts) records were retained in emission order; all later candidates were dropped without replacement, sorting, deduplication, or severity preference.
diagnosticsSemantics.ordinalRule: Retained ordinals were the exact prefix starting at zero. nextOrdinal advanced on every attempted emission, including dropped emissions.
diagnosticsSemantics.countEquality: diagnosticRecordsAccepted equaled records.length; diagnostics.droppedCount equaled diagnosticRecordsDropped exactly.
diagnosticsSemantics.messageBoundaries: ASCII and multibyte UTF-8 messages at exactly 4096 bytes validated; 4097-byte ASCII and 4098-byte multibyte messages rejected.
diagnosticsSemantics.cancellationAndFault: Independently constructed cancelled and faulted completions both retained owned DiagnosticsData and exact BudgetUsage and validated without HostTermination, code, exit, handle, or borrowed state.

semanticNeutralityAndEvidence.resultDetail: For every variant, changing diagnostic capacity, retained record content, messages, dropped count, and all BudgetUsage fields left findings/partialFindings, exact Coverage, deficiency, policy outcome, and fault cause unchanged and yielded byte-identical strict-JSON evidence projections. Distinct execution:a and execution:b AttemptMetadata values supplied no projection field and yielded the same projection for identical semantic completions.
semanticNeutralityAndEvidence.coreIdentityRule: AttemptMetadata is the exact closed record {executionId}; the core has no entropy field and the contract assigns minting to host admission only.
semanticNeutralityAndEvidence.evidenceLimit: These are equality commitments for the candidate conformance grammar, not the product EvidenceDigest grammar and not execution evidence from Rust.
